主要内容: On March 13, 2015, Core Laboratories N.V. and Core Laboratories (U.S.) Interests Holdings, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 1 to their Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment increased the aggregate borrowing commitment under the existing credit facility from $350 million to $400 million, using the accordion feature of the Amended Credit Agreement in its entirety. It also maintains the accordion option to increase the commitment under the credit facility by $50 million (to $450 million), if certain conditions are met. The amendment was filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference. This change affects the company's financial obligations and may influence its operations and capital structure within the energy services industry.
